name: root-guardian
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single production character-state atlas for a monochrome e-reader fantasy RPG mockup. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: borrow smooth confident black contours and clean white/light/mid/dark gray cel shading. Do NOT borrow the friendly faces, puppy anatomy, happy mood or huge cute eyes. Enemies must look genuinely hostile and monstrous while staying in the same illustrated universe as PET-style heroes. Broad readable shapes at 180px high, strong black outer outlines, 4 clean gray values plus white, no color, no texture noise, no halftone, no pixel art, no gradients. Transparent background, opaque white interiors. No aura, no glow, no scenery, ground, cast shadow, labels, text or panel borders. All silhouettes complete with safe outer margins and no cropped horns, claws or feet. Exactly THREE equal columns, ONE row. The SAME full-body enemy in three states: LEFT ready to attack; CENTER weakened and staggered, one knee bent and armor visibly cracked; RIGHT defeated, slumped on one knee with head bowed, claws resting on ground, eyes closed, still recognizably the same intact creature. Enemy identity: a hulking forest horror made of gnarled dark bark and rough stone, broad torso, two broken antler-like thorn horns, huge long clawed forearms, angular root shoulders, thick legs. Face is a narrow skull-like wooden mask with small deeply recessed glaring eyes and a downward grim mouth, threatening and grim, no smile. Four-head-tall proportions, heavy imposing silhouette. No blood, no detached body parts. Keep model proportions, head design and ornaments identical across states. Equal native camera size and common feet baseline for all three cells, generous transparent separation.
